import re

def slugify(value: str) -> str:
    # Lowercase
    value = value.lower()
    # Replace non-alphanumeric with hyphens
    value = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', value)
    # Trim leading/trailing hyphens
    return value.strip('-')
